PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU
